messages.subject: Save ggplot with insets
parts:
Hi all,

as a minimal example, lets say I have two ggPlots where the second one is used as in inset in the first using grid, i.e.

print(plot1, vp = v1)
print(plot2, vp = v2)

In this case, I cannot use ggsave as it only returns plot2. Using cairo_pdf or pdf, I get the wrong fontsizes. Is there a way to set last_plot() to the exact graph seen on the device?

Thanks and best regards,
Jörg

messages.author: 2401d0740178cf07
messages.subject: Re: Save ggplot with insets
parts:
Jörg,

In cases like that I usually use dev.copy2pdf()
 
Greetings,
